title: Birds drawn by code
excerpt: Procedural birds you blend by dragging across a map, with the code that draws them.
content_html: Home Blog Projects Fun zone
content_text: Home Blog Projects Fun zone A procedural bird generator that an agent wrote for me as readable code. Each bird is a set of 46 numbers and 17 colors. Drag on the map to blend the birds nearby, and open the panel underneath to read the code.
